integrity: The infinite-horizon Gramian is summed entrywise. The condition-number objective is reduced exactly to a one-variable trace-determinant quotient, whose unique interior minimizer is derived analytically. The resulting equality of modal diagonal energies and hyperbolic-separation formula are algebraic consequences. An exact rational example is replayed by the standalone checker; finite computation is not used as the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for a stable real two-mode diagonal discrete-time system with one scalar actuator whose direction is free. The classification does not extend unchanged to nonnormal coordinates, finite horizons, multiple inputs, or dimensions above two. Condition number measures directional anisotropy rather than absolute control authority.
title: Exact condition-optimal scalar actuator for a two-mode discrete-time Gramian
